_about: Example policy for a freelance video editor. Illustrative, not a tested configuration.
Calendars: 'edit' (edit and colour sessions), 'delivery' (client review and final delivery).
Event notes carry the folder name as 'folder: 2026-11 Acme Brand Film'.

rules.note: Editing libraries are databases. Never evict inside them; better, keep them out of synced folders.
Project files are small and opened every day.
Proxies let you keep cutting while the camera originals are back in the cloud.
Usually small next to the footage.
The whole project folder, 2 days before the session until 7 days after.
Masters stay at hand for re-delivery requests during the 30 days after delivery.
Camera originals are the bulk: roughly 300 GB per hour of 4K ProRes 422 HQ.
